Summer breaks are over. New session is going to start.
Summer school is going to start. Parents are prepared to send their young ones to primary schools. Letting off the head for the day means a lot over your health as a parent and you can do whatever you want when children are not in home, am I right my love? 

Morning April, wake up. Its already 7:30 and you are gonna be late dear. "Mom is , so loud, I even slept late at night, I should not have watched so much television last night. Mom, was even watching with me how did she got up so early. Being an adult is so hard."
Dad ,"Come'on sweet heart, wake up". Dad comes up in April's room and sits next to his daughter. "April, I am so proud you had such a good grades in your last semester, and I hope you will continue. Your 5ht grade is going to start as well and I want you to give your all to it as well, and yes sweet heart don't forget to enjoy youself as well. If you need anything or be in any trouble just ask me, and I will always be there.". April wakes up, seeing outside the window, what a cozy morning it was. "Yes Dad, of course I will and will be the best girl in the world.","I too will be the best dad I swear.". "Paul, April , come down quickly breakfast is ready and bus might be on its way come down quickly".
"Yes, sweety no time to waste, come down in your new uniform. And don't forget to comb your hair as well."
"Yes Dad, coming right up".
